title: Show an empty Sign-off step before the spec is signed off?
context: When a change will need design sign-off (design-sign-off.yaml applies to its lane), the HUD strip gets a Sign-off step between Spec and Build. Before the spec is frozen there is no design yet. Planning proposes a 'pending' state: the Sign-off bar shows as not started, with no status words and no button, so the row of steps keeps the same length all the way through instead of growing from 6 to 7 bars at freeze. The request lists no state for this moment. (Grounded in docs/modules/design-sign-off/index/summary.md.)
